preconditions.description: The number of passwords n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of failed tries k must be between 1 and 100.
Each password must have a length of at most 100 characters.
The number of passwords provided must match the specified number n.
The Codehorses password must be one of the provided passwords.

postconditions.description: The best case time must be at least 1 second.
The worst case time must be at least as long as the best case time.
The output must contain the best and worst case times separated by a space.
